title: Check build status and include it in any review output
body: Before saying work is complete, verify the build tag (e.g., build-green-YYYY-MM-DD-N) is on HEAD and the commit hash matches. Include the build tag and hash in peer review output. A passing build is a required output, not optional verification.
source_ref: rules.md:R08; high-quality tasks — every approved task includes build tag and commit hash
